summary: 303 of 305 people got out, but the last one left at 542 s. Smoke in the fire room (r_A105) reaches 1.8 m at about 121 s, so the margin is -421 s. Two problems drive this: slow pre-movement (median 71 s, p90 166 s, visitors slowest) and two mobility-impaired people left waiting at stair refuges because there is no assisted evacuation plan. Exit width and queueing are not the problem: there was almost no queueing and exit capacity is well above what is needed. Several single rooms, if lost, cut off many other rooms.

findings.title: Required egress time is far longer than the time before smoke arrives
findings.detail: The last person left at 542 s. Smoke reaches 1.8 m in r_A105 at 121 s, giving a margin of -420.9 s.

findings.title: Mobility-impaired people left at refuges
findings.detail: Two people, a_029 in r_A300B and a_253 in r_C200D, were still waiting for help at 600 s. No assisted evacuation plan exists.

findings.title: Pre-movement time dominates; visitors are slowest
findings.detail: Median pre-movement was 71 s with p90 at 166 s. Visitors had a median of 90.5 s, and the last visitor left at 542 s. Staff were quick (27.5 s). Queueing was close to zero.

findings.title: Exit use is uneven; three exits unused
findings.detail: exit_1_02 reached 1.20 of the 1.3 p/s/m cap. exit_1_08, exit_1_10 and exit_1_12 were not used at all, and exit_1_07 (2.0 m wide) took only 6 people.

findings.title: Single points of failure
findings.detail: Losing r_B19 strands 30 rooms; losing r_A300 strands 22 rooms.

recommendations.title: Assisted evacuation plan with named helpers for the L2 and L3 refuges
recommendations.why: Without assigned helpers, people at refuges wait indefinitely.
recommendations.expected_effect: The two refuge stragglers are evacuated.

recommendations.title: Direct PA message at alarm
recommendations.expected_effect: Lower median and p90 pre-movement; earlier last exit.

recommendations.title: Fire warden on L3 to sweep the floor
recommendations.why: Wardens get people moving faster and direct them to exits.

recommendations.title: Signs toward the unused exit_1_08
recommendations.why: Occupants know few exits, so some exits go unused.
recommendations.expected_effect: Load spread more evenly across exits.

recommendations.title: Add exit at door_3_089 (r_A310) with an outside stair
recommendations.why: r_A300 is a single point of failure for 22 rooms.
recommendations.expected_effect: An L3 route that does not depend on r_A300.

recommendations.title: Add exit at door_2_166 with an outside stair
recommendations.why: r_A203B is a single point of failure for 9 rooms.
recommendations.expected_effect: An L2 route that bypasses r_A203B.

recommendations.title: Widen exit_1_02 to 1.38 m
recommendations.why: Its peak flow (1.20 p/s/m) is close to the 1.3 p/s/m cap.
recommendations.expected_effect: More capacity at the busiest exit.

recommendations.title: Add exit at door_A_071 (LA) with an outside stair
recommendations.why: r_B19 is a single point of failure for 30 rooms, and the LA stairs show queues.
recommendations.expected_effect: A second way out of LA.
